tag: understand: What was the average transaction value last month?

state.question: What was the average transaction value last month?

intent.instructions: What kind of analytics question is `question`?

criteria.lookup: A single figure for one period: what was, how much, how many
criteria.compare: One figure in one period against another period: compare, versus, vs last month, up or down on
criteria.trend: How a figure moved over time: trend, over time, daily, hourly, by day or by hour, how has it moved
criteria.breakdown: How a total splits across groups, or the mix or share of each group, possibly by month
criteria.ranking: Which group is highest or lowest: which, top, worst, best, most, least, rank
criteria.explain_change: Why a figure went up or down: why, what drove, what explains the change
criteria.record_listing: Individual records: list or show specific payments, refunds or chargebacks
criteria.out_of_scope: Cannot be answered from payment records: predictions, forecasts, credit risk, judgements about people, or data not held
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

criteria.captured_value: Captured payment value: Total rand value of successfully captured payments (sales, takings, volume in rand). Not revenue.
criteria.payment_count: Payment count: Number of captured payments (transactions, orders paid, how many payments).
criteria.average_transaction_value: Average transaction value: Average rand value per captured payment (basket size, ATV, average order value).
criteria.approval_rate: Approval rate: Share of authorization attempts that were approved (acceptance, success rate, declines inverted).
criteria.refund_rate: Refund rate: Refunded rand value as a share of captured value.
criteria.chargeback_rate: Chargeback rate: Chargebacks (disputes) received as a share of captured payments, count-based. Use for any question about chargebacks or disputes.
criteria.payment_method_share: Payment-method share: Each payment method's share of captured value (method mix, wallets vs card).
criteria.unique_customers: Unique customers: Number of distinct (pseudonymised) customers or accounts with a captured payment.
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

period.instructions: Which time period does `question` ask about? For a comparison, pick the more recent period.

criteria.today: Today, the latest day in the data
criteria.last_7_days: The last 7 days, this week or the past week
criteria.month_to_date: This month or month to date (the current month)
criteria.last_month: Last month: the previous calendar month as a whole
criteria.last_90_days: The last 90 days or the last three months
criteria.last_6_months: The last six months, all the data, or month by month over the whole period
criteria.custom: A specific date or range not listed above: a named day or month, a quarter, a date like 25 September, or two named periods to compare
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

breakdown.instructions: Does `question` ask to split, group or rank the metric by something? If so, by what?

criteria.payment_method: Payment method: Card, Apple Pay, Pay by Bank, Capitec Pay or PayShap Request
criteria.issuer_bank: Issuer bank: The bank that issued the card or holds the paying account
criteria.store: Store: One of about 40 physical stores (in-store payments only)
criteria.customer_type: Customer type: New (account under 30 days old) vs returning customers
criteria.promotion: Promotion: Promotion code used (Winter Warmers, Spring Sale) or no promotion
criteria.card: Card: Individual card, by card fingerprint (fp_...)
criteria.customer: Customer: Individual customer, by pseudonymised ID (cus_...)
criteria.hour_of_day: Hour of day: Hour of the day as a category, for 'which hour' questions (not for hour-by-hour trends)
criteria.day_of_week: Day of week: Weekday as a category, for 'which day of the week' questions
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

grain.instructions: Does `question` ask for the metric to be shown as a series of steps over time (by hour, by day, by week or by month)? A period named in the question, such as 'this month', is not a granularity.

criteria.hour: Hour by hour: the question says hourly, by hour or hour by hour
criteria.day: Day by day: the question says daily, by day or each day
criteria.week: Week by week: the question says weekly or by week
criteria.month: Month by month: the question says monthly, by month or each month, asking for several months side by side
criteria.not_stated: No granularity is asked for. A period such as 'this month', 'last month', 'this quarter' or 'yesterday' only says which time to look at; it is not a granularity
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

rank_direction.instructions: If `question` asks which group is highest or lowest, which end does it want?

criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

limit.instructions: How many items or records does `question` ask for?

criteria.one: One (the single highest, lowest or latest)
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

record_type.instructions: If `question` asks to list individual records, which kind?

criteria.not_records: Not a request for individual records
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

out_of_scope.instructions: Can `question` NOT be answered from a merchant's payment records?

criteria.true: It asks for a prediction or forecast, credit or default risk, a judgement about a person, or data payment records do not hold, such as profit, margin, cost, stock or real identities
criteria.false: It can be answered by adding up, counting, comparing or listing captured payments, authorization attempts, refunds or chargebacks, for any period, group or time series

amount_filter.instructions: `question` limits payments by a rand amount threshold or range, for example 'over R5,000' or 'under R200'.

filter_payment_method.instructions: Does `question` restrict the data to one payment method? If so, which?

criteria.no_filter: Not restricted to a single payment method
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

filter_issuer_bank.instructions: Does `question` restrict the data to one issuer bank? If so, which?

criteria.no_filter: Not restricted to a single issuer bank
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

filter_channel.instructions: Does `question` restrict the data to one channel? If so, which?

criteria.no_filter: Not restricted to a single channel
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

filter_customer_type.instructions: Does `question` restrict the data to one customer type? If so, which?

criteria.no_filter: Not restricted to a single customer type
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question

filter_promotion.instructions: Does `question` restrict the data to one promotion? If so, which?

criteria.no_filter: Not restricted to a single promotion
criteria.none_of_these: None of these fits the question
